verdict.line: You lose if you facecheck his Q stun pre-6 or walk into his ult when yours is up; you win every extended trade once E (Test of Spirit) is online.

brief.thesis: Illaoi wins this lane in the measured data (53.8% over 1179 games) because her E (Test of Spirit) and passive tentacles punish any extended trade, while Volibear's kit is built around short-range burst (Q, W) that can't out-damage a vessel fight. The one structural threat is his R (Stormbringer), which can land on your tentacles and clear them, so his real counterplay window is narrow and tied to that single cooldown.

theirWindow.when: Levels 1-2, before your E is up
theirWindow.what: Volibear's Q (Thundering Smash, 12s CD at rank 1) stuns and damages the first target hit at 300 range, and his W (Frenzied Maul, 5s CD) rewards a double-cast with bonus damage plus a heal. Before you have E online at level 3, don't let him get a free Q-stun into back-to-back W casts.

yourWindow.when: Level 3+, once E (Test of Spirit) is ready
yourWindow.what: E has 900 range, well outside his Q/W engage range, and forces him to either eat the spirit damage or run — either way he's either taking echoed damage or becoming a Vessel that spawns Tentacles for your passive to heal off. Use it on cooldown (14-16s) every time it's up and he's near your terrain.

start.why: Measured as the top start into this matchup (54.9% WR, 807 games) — the extra sustain and damage matter because your plan is to win trades through attrition, not burst.

boots.why: Highest-winrate boots option (55% over 764 games) — tenacity cuts the duration of his Q stun, which is the only hard CC he has to lock you into a bad trade.

core.why: First item in the top-performing build path (65.7% WR, 166 games) — the armor shred compounds every time you stack it in the extended fights this matchup wants.
Second in the same path — the slow-on-proc helps you stick to him through his passive attack-speed ramp instead of getting kited in a short trade.
Closes out the top build path — the shield and tenacity bonus keep you alive through his Q-stun-into-W combo during the all-in window.

runes.keystoneWhy: The higher-pickrate page (42.2% pick, 53.9% WR) — Grasp's proc rewards exactly the attrition-style trading this matchup is built around, stacking health while you force him into vessel fights.

summoners.why: The highest-pickrate and highest-winrate combo (56.8% pick, 53% WR) — Teleport lets you reset onto the wave after winning extended trades, which is where this matchup's edge actually shows up.

playing.title: Lead with E, not Q
playing.detail: Open trades with E (Test of Spirit) at 900 range rather than closing to his 300-325 range kit. It punishes him regardless of whether he fights the spirit or runs.

playing.title: Respect his Q pre-6
playing.detail: Thundering Smash (12s CD at rank 1) stuns and damages the first target hit — don't walk into his 300 range without it on cooldown before you have the item/level advantage to no-sell the follow-up.

playing.title: Count his W recasts
playing.detail: Frenzied Maul (5s CD) marks on first cast and heals him on the second — if he gets two uninterrupted casts off, he's sustaining through your trade. Interrupt or disengage before the second cast lands.

playing.title: Only ult when his R is down
playing.detail: His Stormbringer can land on your tentacles from your R (Leap of Faith) and clear them outright once he's level 6. Save your ult for windows where his R is on cooldown (160-110s), not just when you have numbers.

playing.title: Fight near your tentacles
playing.detail: Your passive spawns Tentacles on nearby impassable terrain — position trades so they're in range to swing and heal you off every hit that lands on him.

playing.title: Push waves before level 6
playing.detail: Use your level 3-5 E advantage to shove lane and deny his Sky Splitter (16s CD, 1200 range) poke angles before his kit comes online.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, boots, and summoner picks are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the win rates, pick rates, and sample sizes are real. The tactical reasoning — why each pick works, the timing windows, and the ability-cooldown callouts — is my own read on the matchup.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Volibear when he uses (E) to engage. Volibear can use (R) to counter the tentacles from [R] after reaching level 6, so engage only when (R) is on cooldown.
